content:
Maya: Heads-up — ACME tightened pilot window. They want private EU deploy + quantized model support in ~6w. Can we swap priorities?
Diego: What are the non-negotiables from ACME? latency SLA, KMS, data residency?
Maya: They listed p95 < 150ms, EU-only data, KMS + audit events, ability to roll back to fp16.
Omar: Runtime note: adding 8-bit inference path + compatibility tests ~10 working days if we can reuse our quant lib. Otherwise add extra week.
Lina: Infra: VPC peering + dedicated capacity reservations in EU need planning. We have an available peering window but will require an infra change freeze exception.
SecOps: Security requires KMS integration review and logging proof. We also want a short threat-model for on-prem connectors. Estimate 4 business days for review + fixes.
Diego: Product trade: to hit 6w we should cut UI work. Propose API-only pilot, single EU region, no ensemble-routing in pilot.
Maya: Agreed. Minimal scope: API, quant path, KMS, canary, rollback. No UI or ensemble.
Omar: Can we reuse redwood-quant v0.8? If yes, I can get a dev branch with perf harness in 5 days. If no, add 7 days.
Lina: InfraBot: EU VPC peering slot open on 2026-04-12. Capacity reservation windows next week.
SecOps: Conditions for sign-off: canary with audit events for model loads, IaC reviewed, and documented rollback steps.
Diego: We'll provide a customer eval set and acceptance criteria. Propose 95% parity on critical prompts and pass perf thresholds.
Maya: Owners: Omar runtime, Lina infra, SecOps security review, Diego customer comms and acceptance tests.
Omar: Rollout plan: dev -> internal perf -> 10% canary (EU) -> escalate to 100% if p95 within 10% of baseline. Auto-fallback to fp16 on regression.
Diego: I'll update roadmap and deprioritize ensemble + telemetry UI for next sprint.
Lina: Need infra change freeze exception request. I'll file it this afternoon.
SecOps: I'll start threat model doc and list required reviewers.
Maya: Thanks — I'll confirm scope with ACME and share updated timeline. :thumbsup:
